statements: Add book(store, { room, start, end, user }, now) to src/bookings.mjs, following the booking rules in the README. It returns the saved booking with status confirmed and an id from store.nextId.
A time that breaks the rules throws HttpError 422 invalid_time. A clash throws HttpError 409 conflict.
freeSlots(store, room, from, to) in src/availability.mjs must agree with book: anything inside a slot it offers can be booked.
Times are whole minutes since the epoch. The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add room booking, as the numbered statements describe. The README holds the rules. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
